build.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS under WSL, TeX Live 2023, pdfTeX 1.40.25, latexmk 4.83, Poppler 24.02.0
build.result: Two clean builds from the extracted source archive produced byte-identical 20-page PDFs. Final LaTeX logs contained no warnings or overfull or underfull boxes. Inspected Poppler renders of all pages and checked the abstract, title, author, theorem labels and bibliography against the source.

fixed_prime.result: Checked the coherent return and exact rational moment in four cases (p,N) = (5,31), (5,781), (11,133), (17,307). At (5,31), the orbit calculation gives 5-rank 42 and the digit calculation counts six eligible labels. The order-504 top coefficient is one modulo five.

fixed_cover.result: The four retained prime-cube examples have residues 182, 186, 23, 46. At n=35, exhausts the 24 unit classes, checking the seven nonsplit certifying classes and detecting a quotient-dimension mismatch at every nonidentity class. At (p,iterate) = (29,2), (43,4), (79,6), (3,12), (29,4) the direct and translated residues match as 1, 14, 67, 0, 1.

replays.scope: The six historical replay records apply to the same retained verifier bytes. New local replays have the scopes stated below. The uniform cutoff, arithmetic attachment, monodromy and period-theoretic implications use written proofs. Formal sharpness supplies a coherent direction; its realization by an actual Frobenius input remains open.

moving_branch.result: SageMath 10.9 checked all three rational identities against the complete coefficient matrices for odd degrees 1, 3 and 4 from archived verifier bytes.

marked_rank.result: Checked conductor-54 and conductor-162 rank bounds and dimensions, the 229 block determinant 137, the rigidity congruence 26 and the allowed marker counts for interpolation.

escaping_variations.result: Checked critical-point substitutions over Q[Z]/(R), the finite-field irreducibility, nondegeneracy and critical-value power-basis certificates, and the finite marked determinants. The full-support witness and radial leading coefficient reduce to 3 and 789 modulo 1009.

escaping_scalings.result: Checked the two escaping scalings and the stated local residue expansions and reductions.

fourteen_row_integral_places.result: Passed from extracted verifier bytes identical to those in the final archive. Checked residual unit ideals modulo all nine listed primes, including 331 where the leading quotient has length 84.

seventeen_row_finite_algebra.result: Passed from extracted verifier bytes identical to those in the final archive. Checked the common-root norm, exact quadratic component cuts, rank-84 finite projection, and the off-component chart. Replayed the simple modulo-11 blind solution through shift 12 with shift 13 nonzero, the exact degree-12 unit identity on ell=v=0, and the six stated exact integral-place unit certificates. literature: Bouw, Definition 2.1, Lemmas 4.3 and 5.1 and Theorem 6.1 (character dimensions, stable rank, coefficient formula and the generic bound).
Li, Mantovan, Pries and Tang (2019), Theorem 3.2 (Newton slopes for tame three-branch cyclic covers).
SGA 7 I, Expose IX, (12.3.7) and section 12.4 (the dual-graph lattice of the torus).
Serre and Tate, Theorems 1 and 6 (good reduction via inertia and potential good reduction for CM).
Moonen, sections 2.1, 2.5 and 3.1 (coherent Frobenius, the Hasse–Witt triple and the a-number).
Katz, Theorem 14.3 (Deligne's regularity theorem for smooth open Gauss–Manin connections).
A’Campo, section 2 and Theorem 3 (monodromy from a normal-crossing resolution).
